name: Wooden plough
description: A wooden plough about 2.2 × 0.6 × 1 m: a long draw beam from two splayed handles with worn grips to an iron hitch ring, a small iron-tyred foot wheel under its front, an iron coulter and a pointed iron share on a sole, and a twisted plank mouldboard.

provenance.prompt: A wooden plough with an iron share and two handles, about 2.2 × 0.6 × 1 m.
